payload.text: THE ENV-VAR GUARD KEEPS ITS SHIPPED SET AND NAMES A FEATURE-ONLY LIST (hv, 2026-11-21, by selection in devbin-vc's question dialog, read by devbin-vc at 12:21Z on its date -u; relayed to vc by devbin-vc and not heard first-hand by vc; the question's and options' wording devbin-vc's, the choice hv's). no_intent_home.rs (ST0095 AC-11.3) stays. It gains a separate named list of variables read only under a non-release cargo feature, whose one entry is INTENT_SEEDED_IDS (feature seeded-ids, event.rs); a shipped build must still read exactly the ALLOWED set. The variable is neither CONFINED nor deleted. It rides inside AC-03.3's unit, built by devbin-cc with intent-cc's yes on the shape. This supersedes intent-cc's design (c) of 12:2xZ, which dropped the variable for a sequence file at a fixed path.
